patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Instantly and Kaspr share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Instantly and Kaspr share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Instantly only if your buying job matches “Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light Speed $358” rather than Kaspr's shape. Choose Kaspr only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo ann” rather than Instantly's shape. Workflow advantage: Instantly leans sales-engagement; Kaspr leans data-enrichment, lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Instantly and Kaspr share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Instantly is Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light Speed $358; bundles/credits add-ons; Enterprise custom.; Kaspr is LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo annual headline..
- Company-size focus: Instantly (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Kaspr (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Instantly-leaning sales-engagement vs Kaspr-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management.
- Researched limits: Instantly — Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core; Kaspr — LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies.

Limitations — Instantly: Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core; Lead finder/credits are add-on depth vs dedicated SI databases; Kaspr: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies; Native email outreach/sequencing depth is limited versus engagement platforms.

Poor-fit cases: Instantly is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core · Kaspr is a poor fit when that limitation bites: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies · Avoid Instantly if you actually need Kaspr's motion (LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from )
